key_insight: The paper builds a high-fidelity numerical database for bypass transition that reproduces ERCOFTAC T3-like boundary-layer experiments and exposes major weaknesses in standard RANS transition models.
engineering_relevance: This dataset provides a much richer foundation for calibrating, validating, and improving transition predictions in aerodynamic and turbomachinery design.
method: Wall-resolved implicit LES of flat-plate boundary-layer transition
High-order compressible Navier–Stokes solver across multiple freestream turbulence and pressure-gradient cases
Benchmarking against legacy ERCOFTAC T3-style experimental conditions
evidence_signal: The simulations show satisfactory agreement with experimental skin friction, mean velocity, and fluctuation profiles, while SA-BCM and k-ω-γ models exhibit systematic errors in transition onset and length.
watch_item: Because the database is tailored to specific flat-plate bypass-transition conditions, model improvements may not transfer directly to other geometries or transition mechanisms.
paper_title: A high-fidelity numerical database for free-stream transition
